name: WezTerm
summary: GPU-accelerated cross-platform terminal and multiplexer configured in Lua. Layered backgrounds (images, GIFs, gradients), tabs, splits, ligatures, inline images and a bundled JetBrains Mono plus Nerd Font Symbols fallback.

install.notes: Needs the extras bucket: scoop bucket add extras

windows.notes: Default shell on Windows is %COMSPEC% (cmd.exe), not PowerShell or bash: set default_prog (see default-shell recipe). Stable 20240203 is the latest tagged release; many docs on the main branch describe nightly-only options, each recipe states the version a key needs. No dedicated config validator: wezterm.config_builder() (since 20230320) warns or errors on unknown keys when the config loads, and load errors are shown in an on-screen overlay.

macos.notes: The brew cask installs WezTerm.app and links the wezterm CLI. The nightly cask is wezterm@nightly.

install.notes: Sandboxed; run via flatpak run org.wezfurlong.wezterm. Some host integration is limited.
Needs the upstream apt repo (apt.fury.io/wez) added first, see install docs
Needs the Copr repo: dnf copr enable wezfurlong/wezterm-nightly (that Copr tracks nightly builds)

linux.notes: Wayland blur (wayland_window_background_blur) is nightly-only. On X11 translucency needs a compositor.

font.notes: JetBrains Mono and Nerd Font Symbols are bundled.

blur.notes: Windows (Acrylic, Mica, Tabbed) and macOS work on stable; Wayland blur needs nightly; no blur on X11.

background-animated.notes: Animated GIF or PNG layers animate only while the window has focus; costs GPU and VRAM. No video backgrounds.

shader.notes: No user shader hook is documented. Approximate with background layers (gradients plus image hsb dimming), or use Windows Terminal experimental.pixelShaderPath on Windows.

quake.notes: No built-in drop-down or quake window is documented. Use an OS-level launcher or window-manager rule, or Windows Terminal (quakeMode action) on Windows.

inline-images.notes: iTerm2 image protocol (wezterm imgcat) is documented. Sixel and Kitty graphics support level is not confirmed here.

profiles.notes: No profile concept. launch_menu entries and domains (WSL, SSH) fill the role.
